summary: Automatic academic-merit consideration for eligible master's applicants from outside the EU, EEA and Switzerland with a time-limited study residence permit. HUMANITIES: automatic consideration of eligible MA applicants.
SOCIAL SCIENCES: September intake only; usually 2–3 awards/year.
SCIENCE: first-priority MSc admission; bachelor's GPA above 90%; tuition and living expenses for 22 months. 2025 minimum 98% is historical.
THEOLOGY: partial tuition waiver only, usually fewer than 4/year; fees must be paid before possible later reimbursement.
Yearless admission calendars are not scholarship deadlines.
